name: SCP Shadow Containment
summary:
SCP: Shadow Containment is a fast-paced VR horror Gorilla Tag fan game inspired by SCP: Containment Breach and SCP: Secret Laboratory.

You and other players are locked up inside a dark, SCP facility where every shadows seems like there staring back at you and slowly moving… as you keep walking... and the SCPs are slowly watching your every move... Use Gorilla Tag locomotion to run, climb, hide, and survive as the deadliest anomalies that has broken out of their containment. We the Foundation Secure, Contai
